answer.explanation: wake can mean the trail left on water behind something moving, so a silver path in the lake can appear in its wake; wake also rhymes with lake. The other choices do not fit both the water image and the end sound.

solutionStrategy: Check both constraints separately: first make sure the word creates a sensible water image, then read the line aloud to verify that its ending sound rhymes with lake.
solutionSteps: Read the first line and identify the setting: moonlight over a lake.
Use the phrase a silver path to look for a word that can describe a trail on water.
Recognize wake as a water-related trail or path.
Read lake and wake aloud and confirm that they share the /eɪk/ ending sound.
Choose A because it satisfies both meaning and rhyme; the other choices fail one or both checks.
